memory_update.text: For the enterprise AI agents/data/workflow node, prioritize NOW, CRM, SNOW, OKTA, and DDOG as a balanced software-chokepoint basket: workflow execution, CRM/customer data, data foundation, agent identity, and observability/security.

The strongest software bottleneck evidence points to governed deployment layers rather than frontier model access alone: AI Control Tower/workflow fabric, Agentforce/Data 360, AI Data Cloud/Cortex, AI-agent identity governance, and AI observability/security.

PLTR remains a high-relevance candidate for later layers because Q1 2026 revenue growth and U.S. commercial growth are strong, but the five-name limit in this pass favored diversified chokepoint roles across workflow, data, identity, and observability.

Additional names to test in later passes: PATH for deterministic agentic automation, TEAM for Jira/Rovo developer workflow agents, WDAY for HR/finance agent system-of-record exposure, CRWD/PANW for agentic SOC and AI security, MDB for operational AI data/vector search, ORCL/SAP/MSFT for enterprise systems of record.

node: Enterprise AI agents, data platforms, and workflow automation
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the trusted-enterprise-AI software bottleneck. The highest-relevance chokepoints are not model access alone, but workflow control planes, governed customer/employee data, identity and permissioning for non-human agents, observability/security telemetry, and enterprise data foundations. This pass highlights five companies with plausible direct exposure to agent deployment, governance, integration, and operationalization. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
